astep.docs:
The number of integration steps. Default is `599`. Must be between `0` and `65534`.

*See also: [AS7341 Spectral Color Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as7341#configuration-variables)*

atime.docs:
The integration time per step in increments of 2.78µs. Default is `29`. Must be between `0` and `255`.

*See also: [AS7341 Spectral Color Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as7341#configuration-variables)*
